# Talha Rasheed

He is currently a Software Engineer at Metropolitan Warehouse & Delivery (since July 2024) and previously worked at DynamicBits (January 2022 – June 2024). He is open to new opportunities: full-time, remote and freelance.

## Projects
- Trade360: POS, inventory and accounts management for retail businesses, with rapid billing, automatic purchase orders, attendance and payroll management, and dynamic reports.
- LMT (Last Moment Tour): tour-management web app for selling remaining seats at the last moment, with PayPal integration, an accounting structure, payment and transaction management, and Admin / Super Admin roles.
- Chat App: web-based real-time chat and document-sharing platform for internal communication inside an organization.
- POMS: project system built on clean architecture. Talha implemented the project settings and the User and Employee System pages.
- HR MSPL: HR management system that digitizes medical claims and removes paper-based workflows. Talha built the Employee System User page, the Medical Claim page and the system settings.
- University projects: hospital management, restaurant management, pizza ordering and recipe apps, plus several final year projects (FYPs) delivered independently from design to deployment.
